content:
maya: Drafting short internal RN for tonight's runtime roll. Paste + please sanity-check pin/rollback bits.

maya: TL;DR: runtime v2.4.0 (kernel selector + batching improvements + KV cache reuse). Hosted + dedicated affected. No model weights, model versions, or embedding pipelines changed.

maya: Proposed announce snippet:
```
Heads-up: Rolling runtime v2.4.0 tonight at 02:30 UTC. Expected impact: reduced P95 for long-sequence requests and fewer cold-token spikes.
Canary plan: 4% global for 15m -> 20% for 30m -> 100% if green. Node-heavy (legacy quant pools) held at 0% until 20% phase. Dedicated pools will be pinned to runtime:v2.4.0 during the window.
Rollback triggers: >=3 OOMs in 5m OR error rate >1.8% sustained for 5m OR P95 latency +35% for 10m -> rollback to v2.3.2.
If rollback: run `./infra/bin/rollback-runtime --to v2.3.2` and notify #eng-sre + #support.
Support contact: support+dedicated@redwood.ai. QA smoke run: https://qa.internal/runs/648123-smoke (owner: emma).
```

liam: Can we tighten OOM rule to ">=2 OOMs in same region"? We saw cross-region noise hide a pattern before.

ops-oncall: agree, change to: >=2 OOMs in same region within 5m OR >=5 total OOMs across regions in 10m. Add `./infra/bin/hold-deploy --release 6481234567` to playbook.

maya: updated snippet with the ops language and hold command.

emma: QA will run smoke at +6m and +18m and post pass/fail. If any critical regressions: call the rollback.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] runtime:v2.4.0 -> rolling canary at 2026-11-05T02:30:00Z; owner: maya; plan: 4% x15m -> 20% x30m -> full. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/6481234567

liam: nit: change "held at 0%" -> "held back until 20% phase" to avoid confusion.

maya: done. Final RN posted to #eng-releases and will be copied to #staff 30m before deploy. Thanks :thumbsup:
